name: Monthly Personal Transits: 1-on-1
purpose: A standing 30-minute session each month to look at how the current planetary movements are interacting with your chart and what may be most useful to notice now.
method: Each month I read the current transits against your natal chart and we connect them with the plans, questions, and conditions already present in your life. This is individualized timing work, not the same general sky interpretation I publish for everyone.
bestFor: Established clients who want an ongoing view of personal timing
People with active plans or decisions who want to understand the astrological context around the month
A regular rhythm of reflection that builds on our existing work together
notFor: New clients: a Natal Chart Reading comes first so we have a shared foundation to work from
intakeRequirements: What's on your plate this month
includes: How the month's planetary movements are interacting with your chart specifically
Timing and areas of emphasis worth noticing as you plan the month
Continuity: each conversation can build on what we have already seen together
preparation: Bring the month you're actually facing: plans, decisions, questions, and anything already asking for your attention
